description: Needs an agent might pay for through x402 on Stellar. Listing writers use it to decide what services exist; query writers use it (without ever seeing listings) to decide what people look for. Capability ids tie queries and listings together only for building judgment pools; judges never see them.

Current inclusion fee percentiles and surge pricing state
Asset issuer, supply, holders and stellar.toml metadata

Known-entity labels for addresses: exchanges, anchors, scam flags
Validator and RPC health, network upgrades
